title: The Knight's Light
moral: Hope and courage can defeat darkness.

scenes.text: A mysterious illness spreads across the kingdom.

story: A mysterious illness spreads across the kingdom, causing fear and suffering. Sirona takes on the responsibility to save her people by finding a magical amulet. She travels through the dangerous Forbidden Forest, facing many challenges along the way. After proving her courage by defeating a shadow guardian, she retrieves the amulet and lifts the curse, restoring hope and peace.
